data: self-derived from causal_edges (query=outcome text, gold=causal edge hit key)
metric: retrieval-level: evidence hit rate + mean evidence rank + pool token mass (judge-free)

notes.no-inhibition: DB copy with prevented edges flipped to caused (inhibitory side removed, negative spread gone)
notes.no-spread: engine-level switch (Memory::disable_spread): seeding layer intact (BM25/semantic direct hits, Q-weighted), zero spreading-activation hops — seed-hits-only retrieval over the same store
notes.no-swr: DB copy with chunk q_value flattened to 0.5 (approximates a never-consolidated store; decayed confidence is lossy and not restored)
notes.run: post-fix: activation-aware materialization prefilter (edges_touching_chunks orders by MAX endpoint |activation| DESC, confidence tiebreak); store: real causal.db backup, sleep-consolidated x2 (q_value 115 distinct values after prior run's retrieval side effects); queries: self-derived causal pairs (query=outcome text, gold=causal edge hit key)
